Fields.Name: Start State
Fields.Description: The state the state machine starts in.

Fields.Name: Return To Previous State Event
Fields.Description: The event that returns to the previous state. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Random Transition Event
Fields.Description: The event that moves to a random state. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Next Higher State Event
Fields.Description: The event that moves to the state with the next higher state ID. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Next Lower State Event
Fields.Description: The event that moves to the state with the next lower state ID. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Sync Variable
Fields.Description: The variable the current state ID is written to. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Property Bag
Fields.Description: Havok's attached properties (not used by the games).

Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Event On State Change
Fields.Description: The event sent whenever the state or the active transition changes.

Fields.Name: Start State ID Selector
Fields.Description: Picks the start state when the state machine activates. Overrides Start State when set.

Fields.Name: Wrap Around State ID
Fields.Description: Whether the next higher / next lower state events wrap from the last state to the first (and back).

Fields.Name: Max Simultaneous Transitions
Fields.Description: How many transitions can blend at once. A transition started while this many are active ends the oldest.

Fields.Name: Start State Mode
Fields.Description: How the start state is picked when the state machine activates: Start State (default), synced, random (weighted by the states' probabilities), or by the Start State ID Selector (chooser).

Fields.Name: Self Transition Mode
Fields.Description: What happens when the state machine transitions to itself (from a parent state machine): nothing, go to the start state, or always go to the start state (force).

Fields.Name: Wildcard Transitions
Fields.Description: Transitions from any state: an event moves to the target state whichever state is current.
